newsitem.title: USA: Belden to buy Alpha Wire assets.
newsitem.headline: Belden to buy Alpha Wire assets.

text.p: Belden Inc said Friday it entered an agreement with Alpha Wire Corp of Elizabeth, N.J., to purchase for cash substantially all of the assets of the Alpha Wire Division.
The transaction is contingent on several factors, including review by appropriate governmental organizations. The companies expect to finalize the proposed transaction early next year.
Alpha designs, produces and markets specialty wire and cable and had 1995 revenues of approximately $53 million.
"Alpha is currently profitable, and I expect this transaction to be immediately additive to Belden's earnings per share," C. Baker Cunningham, Belden chairman, said in a statement.
Alpha supplies to more than 1,700 distributors and has a highly recognized and respected brand name, he added.
"The Alpha brand name, customer base and proprietary products will nicely complement Belden. There is surprisingly little overlap between the two companies," Cunningham said.
Belden designs, makes and markets wire, cable and cord products. Its 1995 revenues were $609 million.
